summary_md: **Shoto ([@jojoto_beatbox](https://x.com/jojoto_beatbox/status/2116689117417558521))** summarizes **MASCAL** by Fan et al. ([arXiv 2610.39927](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39927)), which RL-trains each agent to output a calibrated probability its answer is correct so downstream agents know when to trust upstream work, raising multi-hop QA from 47.49% to 59.00%.

referenced_urls.title: Learning Calibrated Confidence for Multi-Agent Collaboration
